reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A68A9 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A68A9-Camera_UpdateViewCone_8.cpp at sha256 7c15759f970e56e3c6857fcd814840b0b80e06a6d81ca0ed30f26f8cc7fee1c7 (recorded implementation.signature: void* __stdcall Camera_UpdateViewCone_8(int32_t* param_1);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.
